# Hosea Chapter 6 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 331v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/HOS_006_page_001.jpg

---

**6:1** "Come [lekhu], let-us-return [venashuvah] to YHWH; for he has-torn [taraf] and-he-will-heal-us [veyirpa'enu]; he-has-struck [yakh] and-he-will-bind-us-up [veyachbeshenu]."

**6:2** "He-will-revive-us [yechayenu] after-two-days [mi-yomayim]; on-the-third [ba-yom ha-shelishi] day he-will-raise-us-up [yeqimenu], and-we-will-live [venichyeh] before-him [lefanav]."

**6:3** "Let-us-know [vened'ah], let-us-pursue [nirdefa] to-know [lada'at] YHWH; as-the-dawn [ke-shachar] his-going-forth [motsa'o] [is] established [nakhon], and-he-will-come [veyavo] like-the-rain [ka-geshem] to-us, like-the-latter-rain [malqosh] that-waters [yoreh] the-earth."

**6:4** "What shall-I-do [ma e'eseh] to-you, Efrayim? What shall-I-do to-you, Yehudah? For your-loyalty [chasdekhem] [is] like-a-morning [boqer] cloud [ka-anan], and-like-the-dew [ka-tal] that-goes-early [mashkim holekh]."

**6:6** "For loyalty [chesed] I-desire [chafatsti] and-not sacrifice [zevach], and-knowledge [da'at] of-God rather-than [me-] burnt-offerings [olot]."

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1-3 — The penitential psalm:** Israel's repentance sounds beautiful — but v.4 reveals it as shallow. "He will revive us after two days" sounds like easy confidence rather than genuine contrition.

**v.4 — "like a morning cloud":** Israel's *chesed* (loyalty/love) evaporates like morning dew. The beauty of the image underscores its tragedy — fleeting, insubstantial devotion.

**v.6 — "I desire loyalty, not sacrifice":** The most quoted verse in Hosea. Jesus cites it twice (Matthew 9:13, 12:7). *Chesed* (covenant loyalty/lovingkindness) is God's priority — not religious ritual.

*— EMET*
